patterns.note: Asymmetrical content blocks where large, bold typography often occupies one side of the screen, balanced by striking imagery or smaller, refined text on the other.
Extremely oversized, condensed sans-serif headings are used as primary visual elements, often spanning multiple lines and interacting dynamically with imagery.
A high-contrast palette of stark white and black is dominant, punctuated by rich, earthy tones and vibrant colors within the artistic photography and subtle gradients.
The hero section features a massive text element that dramatically shrinks and moves upwards, revealing a full-bleed image and accompanying descriptive text as the user scrolls down.
Content sections throughout the page reveal with a staggered fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic and engaging scroll experience.
A compact header with the logo and menu, along with a decorative vertical 'W. Honors' text element on the right, becomes sticky and remains visible after initial scroll.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a scroll-triggered animation (likely GSAP ScrollTrigger) to transform the large headline text, causing it to scale down and translate vertically, revealing the underlying hero image and descriptive text.
Sections throughout the page are revealed using a staggered fade-up or slide-in effect as they enter the viewport, creating a sense of progressive disclosure and visual interest.

The main navigation and a decorative vertical text element on the side are implemented as sticky elements, maintaining their position at the top and side of the viewport after a certain scroll threshold.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold, condensed sans-serif headings (~4-6x body text) create dramatic visual impact, complemented by a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and small, often uppercase, labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (e.g., on buttons, some image corners).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, particularly in hero and section titles, emphasizing individual elements, with a balanced density in content grids and text blocks.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its dramatic, oversized, and animating typography, especially the hero text that shrinks and reveals content on scroll. This, combined with a curated selection of striking, artistic photography and a high-contrast palette, creates a highly dynamic and editorial feel that elevates it beyond a typical marketing site.
